prompts.xuan-paper:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production raster material, background texture for a Chinese cultivation game's UI panels.
Input image 1 is the approved game concept, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate ONLY a standalone rice-paper texture, NOT a UI mockup.
Primary request: fine handmade xuan rice paper in pale neutral ivory / warm off-white, subtle visible natural fibres, very faint cloudy aged mineral texture, restrained antique craft. Match the concept's refined light paper against dark blue-teal cave and old gold metal, but REMOVE the strong yellow/orange cast of cheap parchment. Neutral desaturated ivory base, softly cool grey and a hint of pale jade, almost uniform brightness; no dark stains.
Composition: square flat orthographic surface edge to edge, fully filled, subtle repeatable-looking micro texture, no directional lighting or perspective. Quiet even central 90% suitable for readable dark DOM text.
Constraints: texture asset only. No frames, no borders, no mountains, no people, no objects, no letters, no calligraphy, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no fake controls. Opaque background, no transparency.
prompts.mountain-wash:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent production raster illustration overlay for the approved Chinese cultivation game UI, not a UI screenshot.
Input image 1 is the approved game concept, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, particularly its little ink-wash mountain paintings on the paper panels.
Primary request: a delicate panoramic Chinese shanshui ink-wash mountain vignette, misty layered limestone peaks with sparse pine trees, tiny distant pavilion implied very subtly, elegant traditional brushwork, detailed but airy. Pale muted slate-grey and desaturated teal ink, tiny touches of old bronze. Match the approved concept's restrained paper illustrations.
Composition: wide low horizontal panorama, tallest peak on the right and smaller peaks on left, softly fading lower edges and airy mist holes, self-contained isolated silhouette with generous transparent negative space above and below, no solid rectangular backdrop. It will be placed at the top of a narrow goal card and at the foot of a result card, so keep it a single coherent landscape vignette.
Constraints: GENUINE transparent alpha background including between mist, not beige paper. No text, no calligraphy, no letters, no logos, no borders, no UI, no people, no heavy black ground, no photographic scene. No drop shadow. Transparent canvas around the whole artwork. Chinese ink painting, avoid fantasy neon and bright saturated colours.
